# SC4030: aspect-operation-mismatch

## Meaning

The compiler emitted this diagnostic for aspect operation mismatch. The declaration or generated contract violates a statically checkable SupaCloud rule.

## Fix

Bind the typed aspect to its exact kind and operation name. Route names are METHOD /full/path. Use a generic function for module-wide aspects.

## Reproduction

Place the example below in a focused compiler fixture and assert that `SC4030` is reported with a file location. The fixture must fail before the fix and pass after it.

## Failing Example

```ts
// Expected diagnostic: SC4030
const aspect = defineOperationAspect({
  kind: "command", name: "orders.approve", input: decode, result: decode, capabilities: () => ({}),
}, async (_context, next) => next());
@Command({ name: "orders.reject", permission: "orders:reject", aspects: [aspect] }) class Reject {}
```
